name: Island of Rain & Rainbows
source:
At a struggling studio, Lisa is asked to playtest a kids' game. What she finds is not just bugs – but a haunting mystery woven into the code.

[From [url=https://louise-vn-studios.itch.io/island-of-rain-rainbows]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一家陷入困境的工作室，丽莎被要求测试一款儿童游戏。她发现的不仅仅是错误，而是代码中交织着的一个令人难以忘怀的谜团。

[来自[url=https://louise-vn-studios.itch.io/island-of-rain-rainbows]Itch.io[/url]]
